QuestInfo.name: [Weekly Quest] The Blades of Solitude
QuestInfo.1: Go to #b#m241000215##k and defeat #b250 #o8630000##k enemies. After gathering #b150 #i4009132# #t4009132##k items, go to #m241000220# and talk to #p2230000#.

0.0: Hey, you. Yes, I'm talking to you. You were the kid who wanted to get into the castle, right? I got a small favor to ask. You wanna hear me out? I'll reward you. What do you say?

yes.0: You know what the problem with you outsiders is? You all wanna help beat up the frozen weapons, but when you're done you leave their frosty pieces lying all over where someone could step on 'em!\r\n\r\n
yes.1: Those things aren't just cold, they're SHARP! A fella could mess his foot up real bad, y'know?\r\nSo why don't you be a good hero and collect some of those metal fragments for me?\r\n
yes.2: Now go get rid of #b250 #o8630000##k monsters in #b#m241000215##k. Oh, and don't forget to bring back #b150 #i4009132# #t4009132##k items.\r\n#r(Caution! This quest will reset at midnight on Sunday.)#k

no.0: You afraid of a challenge? Fine! Be that way!

1.0: All right. You kicked some metal monster booty AND picked up after yourself. High-five! I'll just take those metal fragments. Here's your reward.\r\n

yes.0: I'll have more work for you from time to time. Come find me when you're free.

item.0: Hey, I told you to collect #t4009132# items. What are you doing? You need way more. Hurry over to #b#m241000215##k and collect #b150 #i4009132##t4009132# items#k.

mob.0: I don't think you got 250 #b#o8630000# monsters#k yet. Hurry and hunt them down in #b#m241000215##k!
